messages:
allen_sales: Heads-up — enterprise commit (Q2) moving fast. Need a quick alignment on throughput profile + reserved GPU ask before we lock pricing. Main asks from customer: sustained 400 qps text-gen, 800 concurrent users with spikes to ~1.2k for 10–15m, 2 TB/day of embeddings for nightly batch. What do we need to propose?

maria_se: thx allen. do we know target model and avg token/response? that changes GPU footprint a lot.

allen_sales: customer wants a 8k-token context mix, avg response ~350 tokens. model target: open-llama-70b-ish (they prefer open weights) but open to quantized variants. priority is latency (<150ms median) for chat paths, embeddings can be async.

devon_sre: rough calc: sustained 400 qps * 350 tokens = 140k tokens/sec. with batching + int8 quant -> ~6 tokens/ms per A100-equivalent? ballpark says need dedicated pool of ~8-12 gpus for steady-state depending on perf. spikes -> allow burst to 20 GPUs for 15m windows.

patrick_ae: can we offer reserved capacity with burst credits? customer expects committed discount if they reserve. pricing ops needs a predictable min. what would min reservation look like?

capacity-bot: Automated estimate: baseline_reserved_gpus=10, burst_capacity=20 (15m window), expected_p99_latency=160ms (optimistic), monthly_estimated_tokens=5.2B, monthly_cost_estimate=$120k (before discount). See /internal/capacity-estimates for breakdown.

sara_soleng: quick NOTE: embeddings nightly 2TB -> schedule to run in off-peak and use spot/backfill lanes to avoid driving peak. we can offload to separate dedicated pool sized for throughput of batch window.

devon_sre: autoscale policy rec suggestion: min=8, target_util=70%, max=20, scale_cooldown=120s, prewarm_on_spike=true. also set fallback model variant (quantized 4-bit) to keep latency SLOs during infra contention.

maria_se: security question from their infosec: need VPC private deployment + KMS for keys and audit logs for inference. is that doable during POC?

allen_sales: POC timeline is 4 weeks. we can do Private deployment in customer VPC for the POC but will require infra lead + 2-week lead for network/setup. add that to commitments.

patrick_ae: ok i'll surface that to procurement. also ask: can we provide a canary rollback and traffic-split plan in the contract? they want SLA for throughput.

devon_sre: include rollout policy: canary at 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic fallback to hosted model if latency >250ms for >2m. add tracing hooks + token-level cost logs.

maria_se: for pricing path: propose two options — (A) 12-month reserved 10 GPUs + burst pool pricing, (B) 6-month smaller reserve (6 GPUs) + higher usage rate. compute discount delta and present.

allen_sales: thanks — action items: @maria_se prepare pricing A/B by EOD, @devon_sre draft autoscale + fallback runbook, @sara_soleng propose embedding batch placement. i'll update AE docs and loop infra. :thumbsup:

devon_sre: noted, will drop a short runbook here when done.

capacity-bot: Reminder: attach perf baseline from prior open-llama-70b run on 8xA100 to the thread for customer reference.

allen_sales: perfect — aiming to send proposal to customer tomorrow morning.
